messages:
IncidentBot: PagerDuty alert fired: `inference-proxy.p99_latency > 500ms` in region-us-east-1. alert_id=PD-84271
Maya P.: acking. grabbing graphs now.
Alex R.: acked. I see a short spike on the router pool, looks like ~45s. No errors in frontend logs yet.
Sam K.: did it auto-resolve? PD says it cleared after ~30s but then retriggered 2m later.
PagerDuty: alert cleared (PD-84271) -> re-triggered (PD-84272).
Maria G.: checking deployments + autoscaler. can anyone confirm if dedicated capacity had any recent rolling shims?
Maya P.: no user-facing errors in the SLO page, only latency. link: https://dash.redwood.internal/infra/latency?range=5m
Alex R.: paste of `kubectl get hpa -n inference` output:
```
NAME                REFERENCE             TARGETS   MINPODS   MAXPODS   REPLICAS
proxy-hpa           Deployment/proxy      70%/80%   2         10        4
```
Nothing alarming there.
Sam K.: `kubectl logs -n inference proxy-xyz -c sidecar | tail -n 40` shows a few connection reset messages but no stacktrace.
Maya P.: suspect synthetic canary hammering the proxy - saw a coincident spike in synth traffic. pinging synth team @maria_g to confirm. :mag:
Maria G.: yup that region's synthetic job started a backlog job around the same time (we pushed a config tweak earlier). it's possible it retried quickly and caused bursty concurrency.
Alex R.: ok that would explain transient high p99 without errors. can we throttle synth or add a temporary rule to mute PD noise?
Sam K.: propose: 1) silence this PD alert for 10m from eng-oncall 2) rate-limit synth job for us-east 3) monitor for reoccurrence.
Maya P.: I'm going to silence PD for 15m and add a notification to synth team. executing: `pagerduty silence add PD-84271 --duration 15m --reason "synth spike - triage"`
IncidentBot: PagerDuty silence created: PD-84271 (15m) by Maya P..
Alex R.: also adding an autoscaler cushions: bump min replicas from 2->3 for proxy to absorb small bursts while we fix synth. running: `kubectl scale deployment/proxy --replicas=3 -n inference`
Sam K.: done. keeping an eye. if p99 stays > 400ms after 5m then escalate to eng-sre and open an incident.
Maria G.: synth team rolling back the config change now. will post when done.
Maya P.: rollback complete. monitoring graphs... p99 trending back to baseline.
Alex R.: looks stable now, no customer errors and latency back to normal. I'll remove the PD silence in 5m.
Sam K.: note for followup: add guardrail on synth job concurrency and a canary throttling policy to avoid future bursts. filing a quick GitHub issue.
Maria G.: thanks y'all. summary: transient synthetic canary misconfiguration -> bursty requests -> p99 spike -> PD triggered twice -> auto-resolve both times. mitigations: silence, scale up temporarily, rollback synth config, follow-up guardrail. no customer impact observed. :white_check_mark:
Maya P.: closing thread. if anything reappears ping @oncall.
thread_summary: Transient p99 latency spikes caused by synthetic canary burst; PD fired twice and auto-resolved; on-call muted PD, temporarily scaled proxy, rollback applied; no customer impact; follow-up guardrails filed.
